parameters.name: AliyunResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: AliyunResourceTags
parameters.description: The list of Alibaba Cloud tags.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client idempotency token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the create resource group operation.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the common resource group. The name must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_), up to 128 characters.

parameters.name: PaymentDurationUnit
parameters.description:
The unit of the payment duration. Valid values:
- Month: monthly subscription.
- Year: yearly subscription.

parameters.name: PaymentType
parameters.description:
The payment type of the resource group. Valid values:
- PrePaid: subscription.
- PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The remarks for the common resource group. The remarks can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, and underscores (_), up to 128 characters.

parameters.name: Spec
parameters.description: The resource group specification, in CUs. This parameter is required when the payment type is PrePaid.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC to associate by default.

parameters.name: VswitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch to associate by default.
